tools.name: geocode_address
tools.description: Convert up to 5 street addresses to latitude/longitude with a cleaned, matched address and match confidence. US addresses also get state, county, tract, block group and block FIPS codes (US Census geocoder); include_districts adds congressional and state legislative districts, city, school district

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Convert up to 5 latitude/longitude points to the nearest street address (OpenStreetMap), and for US points add state/county/tract/block FIPS codes and congressional/state districts from the US Census geocoder.
